title: Kids Bicycle with Training Wheels - Blue
description:
Great starter bicycle for young riders! This 16-inch bike comes with removable training wheels, making it perfect for kids learning to ride.

Features:
- 16-inch wheels suitable for ages 4-7
- Adjustable seat height (22-26 inches)
- Front and rear hand brakes
- Removable training wheels
- Chain guard for safety
- Bell and reflectors included

The bike is in good used condition with some minor scratches on the frame but fully functional. Tires are in great shape with plenty of tread left. Recently serviced - brakes and gears working perfectly!
